summary: The Playwright tests are compilable and use Playwright APIs correctly, preserving testCaseId in titles. However, selectors like text=Electronics and .product-item may be fragile without more specific attributes or roles. Assertions on page title are somewhat weak to fully guarantee correct page load. The third test lacks proper validation to confirm products belong to the selected category beyond counting visible elements. Additional test data handling and strong assertions are recommended for robustness.

issues.description: The selector 'text=Electronics' is a weak locator that may break if category names change or multiple matches exist.
issues.recommendation: Use data-testids or more robust selectors tied to category elements.

issues.description: Assertions verify the page title contains the category name but do not confirm the page content specifically or URL changes.
issues.recommendation: Add URL checks, breadcrumb or headline assertions, or verify category header text on the page for stronger validation.

issues.description: Test TC-003 checks product count but lacks verification that listed products belong to the 'Electronics' category.
issues.recommendation: Add checks that each product's category or label matches 'Electronics' to ensure irrelevant products are not shown.

recommendations: Implement more robust selectors using stable attributes or test IDs.
Enhance assertions on navigation by verifying URL or page-specific elements besides the title.
Improve test data assertions by validating product category membership, not just presence.
Avoid assumptions about category names in hardcoded strings; consider parameterizing.
Document any assumptions about page structure or product item classes for maintainability.
